release: none. This is an untagged development snapshot, 674 commits after the v2.2.3 tag, and no ECC tag contained it as of ECC main commit d2ef268 (2026-11-06). ECC's own manifests at this commit still say 2.2.3, but these files are not the v2.2.3 release: four of them differ from the v2.2.3 tag.

the full ECC (skills, agents, commands, hooks) is installed separately in Claude Code.
